findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
If a workflow fails while Claude is busy, its failure remains in `pending`. When a same-commit rerun starts, the board emits no completed-workflow occurrence, but this loop keeps the pending event because the item still exists. When the turn ends, the pane submits the old “failed” result while CI is running. The rerun proof covers completed failure and success snapshots, but not the running interval.
findings.title: In-progress CI rerun can deliver the previous failure

why: The Claude Code pane's Board tab is hard to read and shows wrong data in a new repo: every field runs on one line, eight time totals say unknown or 0s, a running review shows round 0 and Review: none, and the Board and Machine tabs cannot be selected from the keyboard
